description: Test cases for Document Intelligence Generator with Confluence wiki URLs and attachments

evals.prompt: Process this Confluence wiki page containing a Product Requirements Document for the Advanced Search feature. The page is in Confluence Markup format and contains: overview, problem statement, solution, key features, target users, benefits. Generate an HTML Concept topic that explains what the feature is, why it matters, and when to use it. Also provide a pre-review report assessing style, structure, and completeness against technical writing standards.
evals.expected_output: HTML Concept topic with: proper title (h1), introduction/overview section, purpose section, key concepts (from features/benefits), when to use section, and related topics section. Pre-review report showing compliance score (target >80%), list of any style or structure violations, and suggestions.

assertions.text: Output is valid HTML with proper DOCTYPE and structure
HTML includes all required Concept topic sections: Overview, Purpose, Key Concepts, When to Use, Related Topics
Document has single H1 title with H2 sections in proper order (no skipped levels)
Pre-review report is generated with compliance score, violations list, and assessment
Compliance score is 70% or higher (indicates acceptable documentation quality)
Key content from PRD (overview, benefits, purpose) is properly extracted and included

evals.prompt: Process this Confluence page that documents the Advanced Search API. The page has a JSON file (search-api-config.json) attached containing the API schema with endpoint parameters, configuration options, and response structures. Extract the JSON attachment and generate an HTML Reference topic with well-formatted parameter and configuration tables. Auto-detect this as a Reference topic type. Provide a pre-review report.
evals.expected_output: HTML Reference topic with: title, overview, Parameters table (name, type, required, default, description columns) for query, filters, limit, offset, sort, include_suggestions. Configuration table for engine, model, timeout, min_relevance_score, cache options. Pre-review report assessing parameter documentation completeness and formatting compliance.

assertions.text: Skill correctly auto-detects document type as 'reference' from JSON content
JSON attachment is successfully extracted and parsed from Confluence page
HTML includes formatted table with API parameters: query, filters, limit, offset, sort, include_suggestions
Parameter table includes all required columns: Name, Type, Required, Default, Description
Configuration options are documented with: search_engine, semantic_model, timeout_ms, min_relevance_score, cache settings
Tables are properly formatted with consistent styling and readability
Pre-review report assesses parameter documentation and formatting

evals.prompt: Take the Advanced Search PRD from the first Confluence page and transform it into a Task/How-to topic that guides users through setting up the advanced search feature. Override auto-detection and explicitly set type as 'Task'. Include prerequisites (what's needed before starting), overview of what will be accomplished, step-by-step numbered instructions for setup and configuration, and post-task verification information. Generate HTML output and a pre-review report checking for clarity, step quality, and procedural completeness.
evals.expected_output: HTML Task topic with: title (gerund form: 'Setting Up...'), overview/purpose section, prerequisites list (system requirements, permissions, knowledge needed), numbered step-by-step instructions (5-7 steps covering: enable semantic search, configure ML model, set up filters, enable personalization, configure timeout, test feature), post-task information (how to verify, next steps). Pre-review report assessing procedural clarity and completeness, checking for active voice in instructions, consistent use of second person.

assertions.text: Document type override is respected - task type is used despite content
HTML follows Task topic structure: Overview, Prerequisites, Step-by-Step Instructions, Post-Task Information
Prerequisites section lists required knowledge, permissions, and tools needed
Instructions are presented as numbered list (not bullets) with 5-7 clear, actionable steps
Instructions use active voice and imperative mood (e.g., 'Click', 'Configure', 'Enable')
Post-task section includes how to verify setup was successful
Compliance report shows good score (70%+) for clarity and procedural completeness
